candidate_workaround: Set PYTHONUTF8=1 before launching any console diagnostic that may emit non-ASCII text.
failure_signature: A Python diagnostic writes its files but fails while printing te reo Māori text through the Windows cp1252 console encoder.
recurrence_guard: Pin UTF-8 in the child-process environment before launch; never delete or transliterate culturally correct text to satisfy a locale-dependent console.
rollback: Retain the encoding failure, give the command zero pass credit, and rerun the unchanged inputs under explicit UTF-8.
scope_boundary: Console encoding and unchanged text only; no cultural authority or content validation is conferred.
title: Pre-launch UTF-8 pin for Unicode diagnostics
trigger_preconditions: A Python process may print te reo Māori or other non-ASCII text on Windows.
